projects.name: Ask Alex — RAG Agent
projects.summary: A retrieval-augmented chat agent that answers in my voice from my engineering knowledge base — grounded, cited, and escalating to me when a question falls outside what it knows. Live on this site at /ask.
details: Built a production retrieval-augmented generation agent on GCP: Cloud Run (Node + TypeScript / Hono, scales to zero) serving a static page and floating widget, streaming answers token-by-token over SSE.

Grounded answers in a personal engineering knowledge base using Postgres + pgvector for cosine-similarity retrieval and Vertex AI Gemini for embeddings and grounded generation — no API keys in code, auth via the Cloud Run service account.

Designed for trust over flash: inline citations as an audit trail against hallucination, and a single escalation tool so the agent hands off to me directly instead of guessing when the knowledge base comes up empty.
Chose pgvector over a managed vector index deliberately — a real vector DB on free-tier Postgres that I can debug by hand the day after deploy.
